verbalization: The visible evidence suggests a potential relationship between (+)-Actinidine and the Synaptic vesicular amine transporter, mediated through a series of targets. (+)-Actinidine is predicted to interact with Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 10B, which in turn is targeted by Pachyelaside-A and another compound, 2-(4-Thia-6,9,19-triazapentacyclo[10.7.1.03,7.08,20.013,18]icosa-1,3(7),5,8,10,12(20),13,15,17-nonaen-2-yl)ethanamine. Both of these compounds are predicted to have the Synaptic vesicular amine transporter as their target. The scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with slightly higher confidence in the second path. The evidence suggests a possible pathway where (+)-Actinidine may influence the Synaptic vesicular amine transporter through its interaction with these intermediaries. However, the exact mechanism of action and the strength of the interaction require further experimental validation.
